set.body: Part of Epic bd-01KWVWM8ZP57V019JT646QA37N. Add numerical robustness tests for GLS/OLS around nearly collinear designs, extreme-but-finite scales, singular rejection, and residual variance/standard error finiteness. Acceptance: affected JVM/JS tests pass with explicit absolute+relative tolerances and clear failure messages.
set.title: Slice 19: ill-conditioned design and numerical tolerance tests
